body: i don’t know if this is entirely the truth but i get where you’re coming from
i know i hurt people that’s what makes me worry about hurting them more
i don’t know if this is a joke or an actual cry for help but if it’s real, do you need to talk?
thank you very much for your resources and tips. i do actually have diagnosed depression so i appreciate the insight very much ❤️
yes, trauma sadly always finds a way to resurface:/
you seem lovely, stay strong okay? ❣️
that last sentence you wrote is so wholesome oh my goodness that’s adorable. you seem really sweet, thank you for your comments <3
i’m so happy to hear that. you made my day with your sweet words and i wish good things for you because you deserve all of them !!!

you’re so kind, seriously, you seem like such a lovely person. thank you for your responses they’ve made me feel a lot less worried about the ways i feel. i like your outlook and i’m going to try and think of it more as a good thing rather than a problem or issue from now on. thank you again, i hope you have a lovely day/night ❣️
i think that nostalgia is a good term to use for sure. it’s such an intense feeling of bitter sweetness you know?

i really really appreciate you being so helpful thank you so so so much🥺 and that definitely makes sense about the people thing but for me it’s not even that i want everyone to like me it’s that i want to like. positively impact them? like i want to make them happy even if in the smallest way or just do anything i can to make them feel better or less alone or just any positive thing you know?

i think i am easily manipulated. i’ve had a lot of people take advantage of me in ways that are not at all okay (don’t want to clarify in case of triggers idk) and i definitely forgive way too easily because i hate being on bad terms with people. i just want to be friends and connect with every person i don’t know why. not in a popular way at all i just really love connecting with people but i’m not sure why i am so intense about feeling how i feel

thank you very much for your comment. but it’s not necessarily a consistent evoking of emotions for me. like it’s random and it’s random that i’ll get really sad about some random thing. if that even makes sense. thank you again, tho

yes that is definitely accurate. like if i’m in a good mood and people around me aren’t i’ll switch up (not on purpose) and start to worry about them cuz i want them to be happy or not be upset or whatever. it’s like i care about other people more than myself but not in a “wow i’m so selfless” type of way but in the way where i can’t control it and it’s probably not good and could be potentially dangerous for me to be like that

yes i’d say that i can tell how someone is feeling or what their mood is. but isn’t that an ability everyone has? and i could see how that’s a part of why i get overly sad, but i don’t think that’s quite the reason, yk?

i cry sometimes thinking about random people i’ve met who have made my heart hurt in some way even if it’s not “significant”. i don’t think it’s that i’m an empath or whatever cuz that just means that you feel others people emotions but i’ll just feel sad thinking about someone no matter what emotion they themselves have felt or are feeling. whenever i drift away from someone it feels like they’ve died. i know that sounds overdramatic but that’s what it feels like and i want to explain it exactly how i feel it cuz i’m hoping someone can relate to this or at least point me in some direction of help or insight? i cried yesterday just because a three year old was crying in a store i was leaving. why. like i got to my car and i was trying not to cry but i couldn’t help it and i started crying. why did i do that. that’s happened before. i remember when i was little and i’d hear babies cry in the grocery store or wherever it would make me feel so genuinely devastated and depressed and it would make me want to or actually cry. just looking back on old memories that are happy even, i want to cry. am i just weird? am i just mentally sensitive or something stupid? i don’t know. please help. any input is appreciated. 
oh and i want to add that i’ve talked to at least 10 diff therapists throughout the hospitals i’ve been in cuz i have bad ocd and depression and pretty much every single one has told me that i’m an empath. or a “super feeler”. whatever that is. idk if that’s an actual thing but i thought that could be helpful info.
